description: An open-fronted chiller case running the length of aisle three, its cold spilling out over the floor in a slow invisible tide. Strip lights under the shelf lip make the produce look better than it is. A curled sign taped to the glass reads PLEASE PAY AT COUNTER — the tape has outlived the ink.

flags.aliases: chiller case, chiller, cooler, produce case

name: Open Chiller Case
